Runtime consumer smoke first hit npm EALLOWSCRIPTS from personal userconfig. A temporary scoped userconfig disabled install scripts; user settings were preserved and the unchanged import/install smoke passed.

limits: Scripted model cognition; no real provider quality or network timing

No full screen-reader or long-duration acceptance
